answer: Proof-of-stake reputation layers offer robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as collateral to reach the network summit. This mechanism forces attackers to incur a real economic cost proportional to their weight, effectively turning the protocol into a ferrous lock against unauthorized identity cloning. Each validator node must verify the liveness pulse of others, ensuring that attackers cannot simply spawn infinite identities without risking the permanent forfeiture of their staked assets.
